sentences.english: I need new trousers for school.
sentences.chinese: 我需要上学穿的新裤子。

sentences.english: These trousers are too long, so I have to roll up the bottoms.
sentences.chinese: 这条裤子太长，我得把裤脚卷起来。
sentences.scene: 试穿时发现裤子不合身

sentences.english: I spilled coffee on my trousers right before the important meeting, and I had to try to clean it with a wet paper towel.
sentences.chinese: 就在重要会议前，我把咖啡洒在了裤子上，只好用湿纸巾使劲擦。
sentences.scene: 紧急处理衣服上的污渍

sentences.english: I bought a new pair of socks.
sentences.chinese: 我买了一双新袜子。

sentences.english: I need a new pair of sneakers because my old ones have holes.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一双新的运动鞋，旧的已经磨出洞了。

sentences.english: I have at least ten pairs of gloves, but I can never find a matching pair when it gets cold outside.
sentences.chinese: 我至少有十双手套，但天一冷我就总也找不出一双配对的来。
sentences.scene: 冬天总找不到成对手套

sentences.english: Put on your warm clothes.
sentences.chinese: 穿上你的厚衣服。

sentences.english: I spent the whole morning washing and folding clothes.
sentences.chinese: 我花了整个上午洗衣服叠衣服。

sentences.english: Every spring, my mom asks me to go through my clothes and donate the ones I haven't worn in over a year.
sentences.chinese: 每年春天，妈妈都让我清理衣服，把超过一年没穿的捐出去。
sentences.scene: 季节性整理衣柜的习惯

sentences.english: Look at those cute dogs!
sentences.chinese: 看那些可爱的狗！

sentences.english: Are those your keys on the kitchen counter?
sentences.chinese: 厨房台面上那些钥匙是你的吗？

sentences.english: I still think about those summer nights we spent sitting on the porch, just talking and watching the fireflies.
sentences.chinese: 我依然怀念那些夏夜，我们坐在门廊上，聊着天看着萤火虫。

sentences.english: It's hot, so wear shorts.
sentences.chinese: 天热，穿短裤吧。

sentences.english: I packed three pairs of shorts for our beach vacation.
sentences.chinese: 我为了海边度假带了三条短裤。

sentences.english: I wore shorts to the picnic, and the mosquitoes bit my legs so badly that I couldn't stop scratching.
sentences.chinese: 我穿短裤去野餐，结果蚊子把腿咬得惨不忍睹，我不停地挠。

sentences.english: Don't forget your jacket, it's chilly.
sentences.chinese: 别忘了带夹克，天凉。

sentences.english: I love this jacket because it has so many pockets.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢这件夹克，因为它有好多口袋。
sentences.scene: 称赞新夹克的实用设计

sentences.english: I found an old movie ticket in my jacket pocket from a date five years ago, and it brought back so many memories.
sentences.chinese: 在夹克口袋里发现一张五年前约会的电影票，勾起了许多回忆。

sentences.english: She wore a pretty blue skirt.
sentences.chinese: 她穿了一条漂亮的蓝裙子。

sentences.english: My skirt got caught in the bicycle wheel, and I almost fell.
sentences.chinese: 我的裙子卷进了自行车轮子里，我差点摔倒。

sentences.english: For the school dance, I spent hours looking for the right skirt and ended up borrowing a sparkly one from my sister.
sentences.chinese: 为了学校舞会，我找裙子找了几个小时，最后从姐姐那里借了一条闪亮亮的。

sentences.english: You're so dear to me.
sentences.chinese: 你对我来说太珍贵了。

sentences.english: This old watch was a gift from a dear friend.
sentences.chinese: 这块旧表是一位亲爱的朋友送的。
sentences.scene: 解释一件物品的情感价值

sentences.english: I wanted to buy a new coat, but everything in the store was too dear, so I decided to wait for the sale.
sentences.chinese: 我想买件新大衣，但店里什么都太贵了，于是我决定等打折。

sentences.english: That bag is too expensive.
sentences.chinese: 那个包太贵了。

sentences.english: The restaurant looks nice, but the menu is too expensive for us.
sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅看着不错，但菜单对我们来说太贵了。
sentences.scene: 商量去哪吃饭时的现实考量

sentences.english: We went to a fancy steakhouse for Dad's birthday, and even though it was expensive, the food was incredible and worth every penny.
sentences.chinese: 我们去了一家高档牛排馆庆祝爸爸生日，虽然很贵，但食物太棒了，每一分钱都值。
sentences.scene: 特殊日子不计较价格的美食体验

sentences.english: Take your umbrella, it's raining.
sentences.chinese: 带上你的伞，下雨了。

sentences.english: Can you take this package to the post office for me?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我把这个包裹带到邮局去吗？

sentences.english: It usually takes me about 20 minutes to walk to school, but today I ran and made it in 12.
sentences.chinese: 我通常走路去学校要20分钟，但今天我跑着去只用了12分钟。
sentences.scene: 比较不同通勤方式的时间

sentences.english: These pens are really cheap.
sentences.chinese: 这些笔真便宜。
sentences.scene: 在文具店发现低价商品

sentences.english: I bought this cute shirt for only five dollars—it was a cheap find.
sentences.chinese: 我五美元就买到了这件可爱的衬衫，真是个便宜货。
sentences.scene: 分享淘到便宜货的喜悦

sentences.english: The sunglasses looked cool and were dirt cheap, but they broke the very next day, so I guess you get what you pay for.
sentences.chinese: 那墨镜看着很酷而且便宜得要命，但第二天就坏了，真是一分钱一分货。
sentences.scene: 便宜商品质量不好的教训

sentences.english: I can't find my other shoe.
sentences.chinese: 我找不到另一只鞋了。

sentences.english: My puppy chewed up my favorite shoe, and I was so upset.
sentences.chinese: 小狗咬坏了我最喜欢的那只鞋，我气坏了。

sentences.english: While hiking, I stepped into a muddy puddle and my shoe got completely soaked, making the rest of the walk really uncomfortable.
sentences.chinese: 徒步时，我一脚踩进泥坑，鞋全湿透了，剩下的路程别提多难受了。
sentences.scene: 户外活动时弄湿鞋的窘境

sentences.english: What a beautiful sunset!
sentences.chinese: 多美的日落啊！
sentences.scene: 看到壮丽日落时的赞叹

sentences.english: You look really beautiful in that dress.
sentences.chinese: 你穿那条裙子真漂亮。

sentences.english: We drove along the coast and the scenery was so beautiful that we pulled over several times just to take pictures.
sentences.chinese: 我们沿着海岸开车，风景美得我们好几次停下车来拍照。

sentences.english: I need a hat for the sun.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一顶遮阳帽。
sentences.scene: 大太阳下觉得需要帽子

sentences.english: My grandpa always wears his old straw hat when he gardens.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷在花园干活时总戴着那顶旧草帽。

sentences.english: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off and I had to chase it halfway down the beach before I caught it.
sentences.chinese: 一阵狂风把我的帽子吹跑了，我沿着沙滩追了好远才抓住。
sentences.scene: 海滩上追帽子的滑稽场面

sentences.english: I lost my sunglasses again.
sentences.chinese: 我又把墨镜弄丢了。

sentences.english: The sun is so bright today; I should have brought my sunglasses.
sentences.chinese: 今天太阳好刺眼，我真该带墨镜出门的。

sentences.english: I sat on my brand new sunglasses and they snapped right in half, so I had to buy another pair on the way home.
sentences.chinese: 我一屁股坐断了崭新的墨镜，只好在回家路上又买了一副。
sentences.scene: 不小心损坏了新买的东西

sentences.english: The museum is free on Sundays.
sentences.chinese: 博物馆星期天免费。

sentences.english: Are you free this afternoon? Let's grab a coffee.
sentences.chinese: 你今天下午有空吗？一起去喝杯咖啡。

sentences.english: The best things in life are free, like watching a sunrise or spending time with the people you love.
sentences.chinese: 生活中最美好的东西都是免费的，比如看日出或和所爱的人在一起。
sentences.scene: 感悟生活中无价的快乐

sentences.english: I need a large coffee today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天需要一大杯咖啡。

sentences.english: This shirt is too large for me; do you have a smaller size?
sentences.chinese: 这件衬衫我穿太大了，有小一号的吗？

sentences.english: Our family is so large that when we all get together for the holidays, we have to rent a hall to fit everyone.
sentences.chinese: 我们家人口太多了，假日聚会时得租个礼堂才装得下。
sentences.scene: 大家庭聚会的壮观场面

sentences.english: What size are your shoes?
sentences.chinese: 你穿多大码的鞋？

sentences.english: These jeans are the wrong size; they're way too tight.
sentences.chinese: 这条牛仔裤尺码不对，太紧了。

sentences.english: I ordered a sweater online in a medium size, but when it arrived, it fit like an extra-large, so I had to return it.
sentences.chinese: 我在网上订了件中号毛衣，结果收到后大得像加大号，只好退掉。
sentences.scene: 网购衣服尺码偏差的遭遇

sentences.english: I made a grocery list.
sentences.chinese: 我列了张购物清单。

sentences.english: Let's make a list of everything we need for the trip.
sentences.chinese: 我们把旅行要带的东西列个清单吧。

sentences.english: I have a to-do list a mile long for this weekend, and I'm starting to think I might need an extra day to finish it all.
sentences.chinese: 我这周末的待办清单长得没边，我开始觉得可能得再多一天才能全干完。
sentences.scene: 面对冗长的任务清单感到压力

sentences.english: Can I try on this hat?
sentences.chinese: 我能试试这顶帽子吗？

sentences.english: I tried on at least ten pairs of jeans before finding the right fit.
sentences.chinese: 我至少试了十条牛仔裤才找到合身的。
sentences.scene: 讲述购物时的耐心寻找

sentences.english: The shop assistant was really nice and didn't get annoyed even when I tried on almost every pair of shoes in my size.
sentences.chinese: 店员特别好，我几乎把我尺码的鞋都试了个遍，她也没有不耐烦。
sentences.scene: 遇到耐心的店员尽情试穿

sentences.english: Do you have any questions?
sentences.chinese: 你们有任何问题吗？

sentences.english: I don't have any cash left, so I'll pay with my card.
sentences.chinese: 我没现金了，用卡付。

sentences.english: Let me know if you need any help with the heavy boxes; I'm just in the next room.
sentences.chinese: 搬那些重箱子要是需要帮忙就叫我，我就在隔壁。
